name: Differential Pair Matcher
blurb: length-matching tolerance for USB, Ethernet, HDMI and similar pairs
intro: Lists the differential impedance and the P/N (intra-pair) and pair-to-pair (inter-pair) length tolerances that layout guides give for common interfaces, in mm, mil and ps, and checks your measured P and N lengths against them.

inputs.label: Dielectric constant εr
inputs.help: Only for converting mm to ps.

examples.title: USB 3 pair from the layout tool

usage: Pick the interface id (usb2, usb3, pcie34, hdmi20, eth1000, mipi, ... or all) and optionally a text filter; give the layer and εr to convert mm to ps. With one interface and both P and N lengths in mm, it returns the mismatch in mm, ps and share of UI and whether it meets the target. Use it to set a length-tuning tolerance or to check a routed pair.
sources: TI SPRAAR7 High-Speed Interface Layout Guidelines (intra-pair skew, impedance targets)
USB 2.0 / USB 3.2 / USB4, PCI Express CEM, HDMI and MIPI D-PHY specifications for impedance targets
Vendor board design guides (Intel, NXP, Microchip PHY application notes) for the typical mm tolerances; rule of thumb where the spec budgets in ps
